name: 31539 · Hazlehurst, GA
findings: ZIP 31539 (Hazlehurst) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 31539 (Hazlehurst) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 31539 (Hazlehurst) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 48% of the typical level).

observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
